name: Finite Obstruction Theorems for Bounded COM Rank
statement: For $r\ge3$, COM tope graphs of rank at most $r$ are exactly $\mathcal F(\mathcal Q_r^-)$. Oriented-matroid tope graphs are the antipodal members of this class, and affine-oriented-matroid tope graphs are its affine members whose conformal subgraphs are gated. Ample or lopsided tope graphs of rank at most $r$ are exactly $\mathcal F(\mathcal Q_r^{--})$. Rank here equals VC dimension.
comments: The finite obstruction families are recorded separately as $\mathcal Q_r^-$ and $\mathcal Q_r^{--}$; each includes $Q_{r+1}$ to enforce the rank bound.
